title: Foundation AD: topology (pdc + dc + gateway)
description: Runs `nexus topology foundation-ad`. Three nodes with their roles: DC-NEXUS (pdc), DC-NEXUS-2 (dc), and nexus-gateway (gateway).

observe.what: Nodes table with 3 entries: DC-NEXUS pdc, DC-NEXUS-2 dc, nexus-gateway gateway

whatProves: FoundationAdAdapter.GetTopologyAsync renders the multi-master AD layout as three nodes with their roles (pdc, dc, gateway).
